args.summary: Over the telemetry window (2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12), 12 pattern-detector insights surfaced across 7 devices: 3 batteries now report "Service Recommended", 2 devices have critically low disk space (2–3% free), 1 device has prohibited software (uTorrent), 5 devices drifted from passing to failing the screen_lock compliance check, and 1 device shows persistent high RAM usage (≥95% in half of snapshots). Several devices have multiple concurrent issues.

claims.text: Three devices have batteries reporting "Service Recommended" since late May: acme-macbook-1 (since 2026-05-30, cycle count 1049), acme-thinkpad-8 (since 2026-05-23, cycle count 1157), and acme-dell-9 (since 2026-05-24, cycle count 948).

Two devices have critically low system volume free space: acme-thinkpad-8 at 2.6% free (26 GB of 1024 GB), low in 25 of 30 snapshots with a trend of -0.51 percentage points/day; acme-macbook-4 at 2.0% free (10 GB of 512 GB), low in all 30 snapshots with a trend of -0.20 percentage points/day.
Prohibited software uTorrent 3.6 was first detected on acme-macbook-2 on 2026-05-31 and remains present as of 2026-06-12.

Five devices that previously passed the screen_lock compliance check are now failing consistently: acme-macbook-2 (failing since 2026-05-22, 22 consecutive fails), acme-thinkpad-8 (failing since 2026-05-30, 14 consecutive fails), acme-mac-5 (failing since 2026-06-01, 12 consecutive fails), acme-macbook-3 (failing since 2026-06-01, 12 consecutive fails), and acme-macbook-4 (failing since 2026-05-28, 16 consecutive fails).
acme-dell-9 shows persistent high RAM usage: at or above 95% in 15 of 30 snapshots (max 6 consecutive days) on a 16 GB device.

Multiple devices have overlapping issues: acme-thinkpad-8 has battery EOL, low storage, and screen_lock drift; acme-macbook-4 has low storage and screen_lock drift; acme-dell-9 has battery EOL and RAM constrained; acme-macbook-2 has prohibited software and screen_lock drift.

caveats: Telemetry covers 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12 only; changes before or after this window are not visible.
RAM constrained detector notes: one reading per day shows high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
Low storage trend estimates are linear fits; days_to_threshold is null because free space is already below threshold.
